name: Activities of extraterritorial organizations and bodies
summary: International and supranational bodies (UN agencies, development banks, regional institutions) have no listed equity, but some publish annual reports or bond documentation. Where they mention AI it is as a policy topic: international AI governance, AI for development and the digital divide, plus modest own use in operations. The short list below covers that policy vocabulary only.
